description: Source code for a crash report processing tool that converts minidump files into a format similar to Apple's CrashReporter, utilizing Google Breakpad libraries.

classes.name: Options
classes.description: Structure holding options for minidump processing, including file paths and flags.

methods.name: PrintRegister
methods.description: Prints a register's name and value, formatting output.

methods.name: PrintStack
methods.description: Prints the call stack frames with module and function info.

methods.name: PrintRegisters
methods.description: Prints the register values for a given CPU architecture.

methods.name: ProcessSingleReport
methods.description: Processes a single minidump file, outputs crash info, stack traces, modules, and registers.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Main entry point to process minidump files or directories.

methods.name: Usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the tool.

methods.name: SetupOptions
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to set processing options.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Program entry point, initializes options and starts processing.
